load_network_resume: load a PyTorch classifier model from a saved checkpoint file by epoch number
save_network_checkpoint: save a PyTorch classifier model state dict to a checkpoint file for the current epoch
get_model_list_latest: get the latest classifier model filename from a directory matching a given key
evaluate_acc_accuracy: evaluate classification accuracy by comparing predicted labels against ground truth labels
accumulate_acc_correct: accumulate the count of correctly predicted samples from prediction and label tensors
